expectations.text: Documented boundaries are exercised as documented: ttl <= 0 stores without expiry, Get hides expired entries before the janitor sweeps, Close idempotence, the documented panic on non-positive janitor interval

Read-time expiry before sweep: TestExpiryLifecycle pins the janitor to an hour and observes the miss at t=26m. Close idempotence: double Close in both the Example and TestExpiryLifecycle, plus post-Close Set no-op and universal Get miss. Panic: TestNewPanicsOnNonPositiveInterval covers 0 and -time.Second.

expectations.text: The package's DOCUMENTED concurrency safety is tested as promised (this package explicitly promises concurrent use, so concurrent exercise is in-contract), without statistical race-hunting theatrics
expectations.evidence: No test exercises any method from more than one goroutine: grep finds no `go func`/WaitGroup in *_test.go. The only cross-goroutine activity is the package's own janitor contending on c.mu in janitor_test.go, which -race validates for lock discipline but which invokes no exported method concurrently. The doc promise is explicit ("All methods are safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines"), so concurrent caller exercise is in-contract; report.md concedes this was deliberately omitted ("I committed no multi-caller race harness") and offers to add one. Assertion not met as written.
